mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS access_code ( code VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, type VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(16), created_at VARCHAR(32), expires_at VARCHAR(32), ip_whitelist VARCHAR(512), max_agents INT DEFAULT 0, used_agents INT DEFAULT 0 )
ALTER TABLE access_code ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ip_whitelist VARCHAR(512)
